[/b][size=4][u]The mod now supports compatibility with the following Town Interiors Retexture mods:
[/u]
[list]
[*][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿[/b][/size]
[*][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15049]Elegant Town Interior[/url]﻿[/b][/size]
[*][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url]﻿[/b][/size]
[/list]
[b]If the Town Interiors Retexture mod you are using is not listed above, you can manually edit:[/b][i][u][CP] Automatic Door\assets\Horizontal doors\Vanilla.png
[/u][/i][b]Or leave a message in the Posts section, and I will try to contact the original author for permission.


[/b][/size][size=5][b]How to use:[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url]﻿ (for door-opening sound effects).[/size]
[*][size=4]Extract the files and place them in the mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=4]Launch the game, go to the Carpenter's Shop, and purchase it for 200g.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Config:[/size][/b][list]
[*][i][size=4]PIF : true/false[/size][/i]
[/list][size=4] [/size][size=3] Default is false.[/size]
[size=3]
When enabled, it allows doors to connect with PIF.[/size]

[list]
[*][i][size=4]Texture : true/false[/size][/i]
[/list]  [size=3]Default is true.[/size]

[size=3]If you don't want the door to be compatible with your Town Interiors Retexture,you can change it to false. This will make the door's texture display as Cursors.png and [/size][size=3]Vanilla.png [/size][size=3]in the assets,allowing you to freely edit the door's texture ^^[/size][size=4]
[/size]
[size=3][b][u]Inspired by: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3797]Better Door[/url][/u][/b][/size]
